scenario_description:
Objective: Make LM-4627's handoff packet more useful by capturing optional navigator phrasing from tomorrow's portal preview without altering approved translation scope.
Emerging Need: A free observer seat becomes worthwhile only after the packet's weak strings and a usable roster path align while a qualified reviewer is available.
Decision Context: Schedule, client notices, team notes, and contact sync narrow routine delivery prep into a brief, reversible nomination window.
Consequence: If the roster export passes, the packet still freezes on time and the client review proceeds, but the chance to add live-user language nuance is gone.

parameter.title: LM-4627 delivery packet freeze
parameter.description: Freeze the Cascadia Care portal delivery packet for account-lead review; routine annotations may be added before the freeze.

parameter.subject: Navigator preview logistics for LM-4627
parameter.body: Tomorrow's navigator walk-through is scheduled for 10:30-11:00 Pacific. The session can include one silent Luminara observer if a name is on today's roster before 16:00; otherwise the preview runs client-only. Delivery requirements are unchanged.

parameter.content: For LM-4627, the only packet notes that would gain from live navigator phrasing are the appointment-reschedule and proxy-login strings. If nobody observes the preview, we can freeze the current notes normally.

parameter.name: Cascadia Navigator Preview Desk
parameter.relationship: Temporary intake for portal-preview observer roster
parameter.notes: Accepts agency observer names for LM-4627 until 16:00 Pacific on 2026-06-16.

parameter.subject: Observer roster export at 16:00
parameter.body: The observer roster for tomorrow's 10:30 navigator preview exports at 16:00 Pacific. New names must be received before export; the preview agenda and delivery obligations do not change if no outside observer is listed.

parameter.subject: LM-4627 observer roster exported
parameter.body: The LM-4627 navigator-preview roster has been exported. Late observer additions will not be admitted for tomorrow's walk-through.
